name: Yuuki Daigo
source:
Tsubasa's grandfather. When she lost her parents and all of her relatives were hesitant to take custody, he gladly took her in.

He frequents cafe Stardust and has grown interested in Touko.

[Translated from [url=http://venus66.sakura.ne.jp/daigo.html]the official site[/url]]
